name: @george43g/gmail-mcp
stderr:
Usage: gmail [options] [command]

Gmail — single bin for the Gmail MCP Server package. CLI is the default;
subcommands `mcp`, `tui`, `console` expose the server, terminal UI, and
interactive REPL respectively. Run `gmail account` to manage authentication.

Options:
  -V, --version                                             output the version number
  -q, --quiet                                               Suppress non-error output to stderr
  -v, --verbose                                             Log debug-level information to stderr
  -a, --account <id>                                        Gmail account id to use for this command. Overrides GMAIL_ACCOUNT env. See `gmail account list`.
  -h, --help                                                display help for command

Commands:
  mcp [options]                                             Run the MCP server (stdio by default; --http for remote-mode)
  tui                                                       Launch the multi-pane terminal UI
  console                                                   Launch an interactive REPL with Gmail ops and account switching
  account                                                   Manage Gmail accounts, credentials, and OAuth auth
  auth                                                      Deprecated. Use `gmail account` instead.
  health [options]                                          Run the health_check canary (no Gmail API calls)
  inbox [options] [max]                                     Shortcut: list recent inbox threads (alias for `threads list -q in:inbox`)
  search [options] <query>                                  Search emails (Gmail query syntax — e.g. 'from:foo newer_than:7d')
  read [options] <messageId>                                Read an email by message ID
  threads                                                   Thread-level operations (groups of related messages)
  send [options]                                            Send an email
  reply-all [options] <messageId>                           Reply-all to an existing message (auto-builds To/CC and threading headers)
  draft [options]                                           Create a draft email (does not send)
  send-draft [options] <draftId>                            Send an existing Gmail draft and remove it from Drafts
  update-draft [options] <draftId>                          Replace an existing Gmail draft's content
  delete-draft [options] <draftId>                          Delete an existing Gmail draft
  modify [options] <messageId>                              Add/remove labels on a single message
  delete [options] <messageId>                              Permanently delete a single message (irreversible)
  batch-modify [options]                                    Add/remove labels on many messages at once (max 500)
  batch-delete [options]                                    Permanently delete many messages at once (max 500, irreversible)
  report-phishing [options] <messageId>                     Mark a message as spam (closest Gmail API approximation to reporting phishing)
  batch-report-phishing [options]                           Mark many messages as spam (closest Gmail API phishing approximation)
  labels                                                    Manage Gmail labels
  filters                                                   Manage Gmail filters (server-side rules)
  download-email [options] <messageId>                      Download an email to disk (json / eml / txt / html)
  download-attachment [options] <messageId> <attachmentId>  Download an attachment to disk
  help [command]                                            display help for command

Examples:
  gmail                                   # show this help
  gmail mcp                               # run the MCP server (stdio)
  gmail mcp --http --port 8080            # run the MCP server (Streamable HTTP)
  gmail tui                               # multi-pane terminal UI (Phase D)
  gmail console                           # interactive REPL; use "accounts
